title: The Cracked Kiln
offer: My kiln cracked in the frost! To build a new one I need six baskets of clay from Ekvik and three sacks of charcoal from Grim to fire it.

steps.load_say: Clay again? Dagny must be building a castle!

steps.say: The new kiln glows! My first pots from it are for you.

fact: A potter's kiln is a small oven of clay, heated so hot that the pots glow.
